$comment: Phase 0 §0.0b candidate registry. Editing this file changes what pull-models.sh fetches and what the tier runner considers 'in the pool'. Do NOT hardcode revisions here — pull-models.sh resolves and pins revisions at download time and records them in models/manifest.json. Per ADR-0013, entries with architectures ending in ForConditionalGeneration (Qwen3.5-VL family) are excluded from coder + planner pools — they carry a vision tower that starves KV cache on a 32 GiB card. Verify config.json.architectures[0] ends in ForCausalLM before adding a coder/planner candidate.
